# Welcome {.unnumbered}

::: {.book-hero}
[Open online book]{.book-hero__kicker}

[How robots, from tiny drones to autonomous vehicles, turn light and other signals into an understanding of the world around them.]{.book-hero__lead}

This book is written for students meeting computer vision and robot perception for the first time. It is built to be used, not just read.

::: {.book-cards}
[[Live demos]{.book-card__label}[Run OpenCV on your webcam]{.book-card__title}[Demos run in your browser. Video stays on your device and is never uploaded.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/features.qmd){.book-card}

[[Editable code]{.book-card__label}[Change it and press Run]{.book-card__title}[Real Python and OpenCV in the page, with nothing to install.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/image-formation.qmd){.book-card}
:::

## Chapters {.unnumbered}

::: {.book-cards}
[[Chapter 1]{.book-card__label}[Introduction]{.book-card__title}[What perception is, why it is hard, and how the era of AI is changing it.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/intro.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 2]{.book-card__label}[Image Formation]{.book-card__title}[Pinholes, lenses, exposure and color sensors, with interactive figures.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/image-formation.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 3]{.book-card__label}[Features]{.book-card__title}[Filters, edges, corners and descriptors, with live webcam demos.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/features.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 4]{.book-card__label}[Projections and Transformations]{.book-card__title}[Homogeneous coordinates, homographies, RANSAC and panoramas.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/transformations.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 5]{.book-card__label}[Camera Models and Calibration]{.book-card__title}[Intrinsics, extrinsics, rotations, lens distortion and calibration.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/camera-models.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 6]{.book-card__label}[Curves and Rendering]{.book-card__title}[Splines, surfaces and how computers draw a 3D world.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/curves-rendering.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 7]{.book-card__label}[Single-View Geometry]{.book-card__title}[Vanishing points, measuring from one image and its limits.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/single-view.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 8]{.book-card__label}[Computational Imaging]{.book-card__title}[Cameras designed together with algorithms.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/computational-imaging.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 9]{.book-card__label}[Learning Depth]{.book-card__title}[Coded apertures and neural networks that estimate depth.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/learned-depth.qmd){.book-card}

[[Chapter 10]{.book-card__label}[Stereo and Two-View Geometry]{.book-card__title}[Epipolar geometry, disparity and depth from two cameras.]{.book-card__text}](chapters/stereo.qmd){.book-card}

## About the author {.unnumbered}

Chahat Deep Singh leads the Perception, Robotics, AI and Sensing ([PRAISe](https://www.praisecu.com)) Lab at the University of Colorado Boulder.
